snippet.title: NASCAR Heat 5 - Next Gen Car Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the historic debut of the Next Gen cars!

Available now: https://bit.ly/3p9GruY

The NASCAR Heat 5 - Next Gen Car Update features the 2022 NASCAR Cup Series Chevrolet Camaro ZL1, Ford Mustang GT, and Toyota Camry TRD Next Gen cars with their primary paint schemes, team and driver roster.

Refuse to Lose with NASCAR Heat 5! Out now on Xbox, PlayStation and PC via Steam!
